Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood for patient message routing (pilot)

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers below: 

- Primary use case: triage and routing of patient portal messages and clinician notes to downstream workflows (automated triage, suggested routing, and short-form summarization for ops teams).
- Expected volume: we currently see ~80k inbound messages/month; target pilot will route a subset (~15–20k messages/month). Token estimate: ~1.1M tokens/month for pilot.
- Pilot timeline: want to kick off a 6–8 week pilot starting mid-December, with a goal to evaluate for a full production rollout in Q2.
- Data sensitivity: contains PHI. We’ll need details on private deployment options (VPC / on-prem) and SOC2/ISO controls; we’re open to a hosted pilot if we can limit data retention and put a BAA in place.

I’ve attached a high-level architecture note for context. Would prefer a demo next week if possible — Mon/Tue mornings PT work for us.

Attachment: cypherhealth-arch-diagram.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

Thanks,
Liz Bennett
Head of Care Ops, CypherHealth
liz@cypherhealth.com
